top_categories.workout_context: 84ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.

Road-specific control matters at NXT Classic. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 93 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic NXT Classic's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before April.
At NXT Classic, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of NXT Classic. Train it until it feels boring.
7,874ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
At mile 60 of 93, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
7,874ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at NXT Classic. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on mixed terrain can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Low-cadence force work supports 7,874ft of climbing when the grade lowers cadence. Practice controlled torque while preserving good form.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 93 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for NXT Classic’s 93 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at NXT Classic. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at NXT Classic rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Road Specific, and Race Simulation to prepare you for 93 miles of mixed terrain in Eijsden, Limburg, Netherlands (start/finish: Heerlijkheid Breust per route/practical-info pages; the official regulations name Vroenhof — sources disagree, not yet reconciled).
